description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called `TalkOverlayView` and associated subviews and classes that manage a graphical overlay for a talk mode interface, including interaction handling and animated visual elements.

classes.name: OrbInteractionNSView
classes.description: A custom NSView handling mouse interaction events such as clicks, drags, and releases to trigger respective callbacks.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and initializes an `OrbInteractionNSView` instance with assigned callbacks and visual properties.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the existing `NSView` with the current interaction callbacks.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events, detecting double clicks and initiating potential drag operations.

methods.name: mouseDragged
methods.description: Handles dragging, determining if movement exceeds threshold to recognize drag start and triggering `onDragStart`.

methods.name: mouseUp
methods.description: Complete click or drag operation, calling `onSingleClick` if applicable.
